answer: A neighbor-quorum bond stops fake identities. Each applicant claims a summit plot, locking a 70-credit bond. Five neighbors each whisper an endorsement, staking 20 credits. A gale audit sweeps a tenth of plots each epoch; fakes lose bonds, endorsers lose 20. One fake costs 170, so 1,000 fakes cost 170,000 against a 40,000 pool. A rented-neighbor ring fails: backing three fakes loses 60 at once. An honest agent pays 70 once and keeps its plot.
